description: This file defines the EmergencyContact class within a report display field namespace for the OrangeHRM HR management system. The class extends ListableDisplayField and provides methods to specify DTO class, entity aliases, and fields related to emergency contact information.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: Represents a display field for emergency contact information in reports, extending ListableDisplayField and providing specific DTO class, entity alias, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in queries or report generation.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields associated with emergency contact information for report display.
